name: Golden Butterfly
desc: Glowing golden butterfly with flapping wings and sparkle trail
code: const s=ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const trail=ctx.trail!==false; const wFlap=Math.sin(mt*7)*5; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; svg += `<ellipse cx="-3" cy="0" rx="${4+wFlap*0.3}" ry="5" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(${-wFlap*2} -3 0)"/>`; svg += `<ellipse cx="3" cy="0" rx="${4+wFlap*0.3}" ry="5" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(${wFlap*2} 3 0)"/>`; svg += `<ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="1" ry="3.5" fill="#8B6914"/>`; if(trail){ for(let i=0;i<8;i++){ const trx = -Math.sin(mt*0.7+i*0.3)*12 - i*4; const tri = i*1.5 + Math.cos(mt*0.6+i*0.4)*3; svg += `<circle cx="${trx}" cy="${tri}" r="${1.8-i*0.2}" fill="#FFD700" opacity="${0.25-i*0.025}"/>`; } } svg += `</g>`; return svg;
